CustomField.description: A formula Field used to schedule "System Archival" Path in 'Account After Save' flow.
CustomField.formula: IF ( OR ( ISPICKVAL(Onboarding_Stage__pc, 'MOBILE_VERIFIED'), ISPICKVAL(Onboarding_Stage__pc, 'DEVICE_PIN_SET'), ISPICKVAL(Onboarding_Stage__pc, 'EMAIL_VERIFIED') ), NOW(), null )
CustomField.label: sched01_SystemArchival
